This '''alien race''' were immense and had pale skin. They were distinguished by their long limbs and tall, wattled necks.
Their heads were dominated by a pair of heavy tusks that protected their mouths and necks, and their long arms gave them an incredible reach. [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]] was a member of this species.
